heading: Wednesday, September 30, 2026
topLine: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon frontier model.

items.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon frontier model
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's frontier model for coding, enterprise knowledge work and cyber defense, with a 1M-token output limit, up from 64K. Google first released it to vetted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program and made it broadly available on October 13. It reports 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, with introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens.
